soundness_flags.label: Definition def:phase-plugin and Theorem 4 (phase inference)
soundness_flags.one_line: The “simultaneous uncertainty radius,” estimated distances to all four boundary types, and selected-branch map are not defined, so \(\widehat s_n\) and its asserted uniform consistency are not yet a determinate statistic.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4 states \(\sqrt n(\hat\theta^{ep}-\theta^*)\Rightarrow G\) and \(nR_\lambda(\hat\theta^{ep})\Rightarrow G^\top HG/2\), with efficient penalized-welfare regret under its sieve-balance assumptions.

source_verification_receipts.version: author preprint corresponding to PNAS 2019 article
source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 2.2 equation (5) and Section 2.3 Theorem 2, lines 229–246 and 259–280
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proportional Gaussian logistic-MLE analysis uses a three-variable state system and Theorem 2 gives its coordinate-average limit; it does not analyze coupled entropy tilts or a nonconcave policy selector.
The paper states that inverse weighting by a nonparametric estimated propensity score yields an efficient ATE estimator and discusses the known-propensity randomized-experiment case.

source_verification_receipts.version: preprint corresponding to Annals of Statistics 48(1), 2020
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited work establishes a sharp existence phase transition for the Gaussian proportional logistic MLE; it is a geometric analogue, not a result for pooled-target entropy balance.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the certified branch map, each boundary-distance functional, and an explicit simultaneous confidence radius; then state \(\widehat s_n\) as a total abstaining classifier and derive its uniform error control.
Promote the threshold theorem into a standalone exact geometric result by giving the strict-alternative reduction and a finite-dimensional numerical certificate for \(\kappa_{\mathrm{bal}}\).
After closing the joint system, add a direct same-sample-versus-cross-fitted equivalence/non-equivalence frontier with two named comparators and an observable threshold.

recommended_next_step: Revise the phase-inference construction to define the classifier and uncertainty radius explicitly, then advance the field-tier joint-system kernel to Stage 0.
